Terrible!!!!!! I took my Pomeranian to this groomer for a bath and brushing service, with a price clearly agreed upon when I handed him over.
Unfortunately, the result was completely disappointing. When I went to pick him up, his fur was still completely rough, full of knots, and there wasn't even the slightest scent or cleanliness you'd expect after a professional grooming session. It almost looked like nothing had been done.
To make matters worse, when it came time to pay, I was asked for a higher price than agreed upon upon arrival, with no valid justification for this extra charge.
Poor grooming, little attention to the animal, and unfair pricing. I will never go back.!!!

First and last time with them!
From such an elite grooming salon, as they would have you believe, you certainly expect more than just professionalism, at least more honesty and respect for the customer. This, aside from caring for the animals and the skill of the staff, is severely lacking. They treat the customer like a money-spitting ATM, and regardless of whether you have money, it's quite annoying to be taken for a ride.
I sent my partner to have two poodles groomed: one miniature (classic teddy bear cut) and one toy. I'd asked for a puppy clip from a show (which, by the way, already had a clip, not a mark, but the old hair was still visible). To make the cut easier, I presented both of them, especially the toy, with washed, detangled, and smoothed fur, long enough to accommodate any cut they deemed appropriate.
Well, when the dogs were handed over at 12:40 PM, no issues were reported regarding the condition of their coats. The dogs were picked up at 5:30 PM (5 hours), and the price was €250.00, a whopping €80 more than the price listed on their website. The excuse was that the miniature had knots and needed to be detangled, and the toy's coat was too long, and the puppy clip needed to be done from scratch. They said the price listed only applies to dogs with a well-defined haircut and for clients who come once a month!
Let's leave aside the excuses they made up when I asked for the reasons; it's surely their modus operandi, given that another client who had just left complained about unnecessary additional services being performed without their consent.
Another negative event that makes me think of the lack of attention paid to animals is that after 5 minutes of taking care of the dogs, they informed me that the 8-month-old toy had broken his leather leash. In just 5 minutes? I'm starting to think he was left tied up and unnoticed, got scared, and bit the leash. If they had been present, they would have prevented the leash from being destroyed. This is my assessment, but otherwise, I can't explain how a dog who's only been in my possession for 5 minutes could do something like that in the hands of a professional.
P.S.: I'm a dog lover, a breeder for over 20 years, a master breeder, and have also taken basic grooming courses, so I'd say I have a modicum of experience and understanding of what I'm talking about.

I'm writing this review with great regret, as I think it's a groomer with very competent staff, but only good, practically fake dogs. Their policy is to groom as many dogs as possible quickly, because they need to make as much money as possible. If you own more demanding dogs, this is certainly not the right groomer, as they'll recommend sedatives and tranquilizers to wash your dog. Not to mention, the grooming costs €80 each for a miniature-medium dog. I should also add that I was advised to give my dog ​​a tranquilizer, for my own benefit, because if the dog hadn't gotten a haircut, I'd have to pay for the three-hour wait. Shame on you!
Just business! In conclusion, if you have fake dogs, bringing them in backwards is a waste of time and, consequently, money.
Good morning, we're sorry to see a negative review without any comments that could help us improve. We invite you to contact us so we can understand your experience and find a solution together.

Really too expensive, and if you don't ask for a receipt and pay in cash, they forget to give you one. An exaggeration of false luxury and, as they say, "it stinks."
REPLY TO THE STORE:
It's too easy to pretend I wasn't a customer of yours. All the reviews I've written are always based on real experiences and are both positive and negative (not just negative). As for the receipt, it wasn't a delay, but rather a greeting from you and my subsequent request for a receipt. Using your products and services is optional, of course, but the consumer certainly has the right to express an opinion. If you don't want criticism, don't expose yourself publicly and don't post reviews on websites. Your positive reviews seem fake (I still have my doubts).
Your response is clearly: the best defense is a good offense.
Thank you so much 💕 …

A bad experience. It almost seems like you have to hope you've ended up in the right hands. As you can clearly see from the photos, the muzzle has been trimmed imprecisely: one side is longer and the other shorter, resulting in a completely asymmetrical appearance.

The ears are even worse, with different shapes and lengths. The legs have irregular tufts everywhere.

Workers can make mistakes, that's understandable. What's unacceptable, however, is the arrogance of denying the obvious. Sometimes, it would be enough to apologize and try to repair the damage. Manners, unfortunately, are a virtue reserved for the few. Thus, the only memory left is that of an arrogant person, not a professional.
